title: test_channel.py: off-by-one in test_sfn_wrapping upper bound assertion
description:
## Location
python/tests/link/test_channel.py:132-133

## Bug
Test asserts `1 <= ch <= 63` with `n_channels=64`, but `synchronized_hop_channel` returns `1 + (h % 64)` which yields [1, 64].

```python
ch1 = synchronized_hop_channel(0xFFFFFFFF, seed=0, n_channels=64)
ch2 = synchronized_hop_channel(0x100000000, seed=0, n_channels=64)
assert 1 <= ch1 <= 63   # BUG: should be <= 64
assert 1 <= ch2 <= 63   # BUG: should be <= 64
```

## Impact
Test could incorrectly fail (false positive) if hash produces valid output 64. Currently passes because specific inputs produce 2 and 38.

## Fix
Change `<= 63` to `<= 64` on both lines.
close_reason: Fixed off-by-one: changed upper bound assertions from 63 to 64 on lines 132-133
